```python
import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr
import math as m

# Create a Chrono::Engine physical system
sys = chrono.ChSystemNSC()

# Create contact material shared among all bodies
mat = chrono.ChContactMaterialNSC()

# Create all rigid bodies with specific dimensions
radA = 1.5
radB = 3.5

# Create the truss
mbody_truss = chrono.ChBodyEasyBox(15, 8, 2,
                                   1000,
                                   True,
                                   False,
                                   mat)
sys.Add(mbody_truss)
mbody_truss.SetFixed(True)
mbody_truss.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 3))

# Shared visualization material
vis_mat = chrono.ChVisualMaterial()
vis_mat.SetKdTexture(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('textures/pinkwhite.png'))

# Create the rotating bar support
mbody_train = chrono.ChBodyEasyBox(8, 1.5, 1.0,
                                   1000,
                                   True,
                                   False,
                                   mat)
sys.Add(mbody_train)
mbody_train.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(3, 0, 0))

# Revolute joint between truss and rotating bar
link_revoluteTT = chrono.ChLinkLockRevolute()
link_revoluteTT.Initialize(mbody_truss, mbody_train,
                           chrono.ChFramed(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT))
sys.AddLink(link_revoluteTT)

# Create the first gear (Gear A)
mbody_gearA = chrono.ChBodyEasyCylinder(chrono.ChAxis_Y,
                                        radA, 0.5,
                                        1000, True, False, mat)
sys.Add(mbody_gearA)
mbody_gearA.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, -1))
mbody_gearA.SetRot(chrono.QuatFromAngleX(m.pi / 2))
mbody_gearA.GetVisualShape(0).SetMaterial(0, vis_mat)

# Visualization shaft for Gear A
mshaft_shape = chrono.ChVisualShapeCylinder(radA * 0.3, 10)
mbody_gearA.AddVisualShape(mshaft_shape, chrono.ChFramed(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 3.5, 0),
                                                         chrono.QuatFromAngleX(chrono.CH_PI_2)))

# Motor for Gear A
link_motor = chrono.ChLinkMotorRotationSpeed()
link_motor.Initialize(mbody_gearA, mbody_truss,
                      chrono.ChFramed(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT))
link_motor.SetSpeedFunction(chrono.ChFunctionConst(3))
sys.AddLink(link_motor)

# Create the second gear (Gear B)
interaxis12 = radA + radB
mbody_gearB = chrono.ChBodyEasyCylinder(chrono.ChAxis_Y,
                                        radB, 0.4,
                                        1000, True, False, mat)
sys.Add(mbody_gearB)
mbody_gearB.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(interaxis12, 0, -2))
mbody_gearB.SetRot(chrono.QuatFromAngleX(m.pi / 2))
mbody_gearB.GetVisualShape(0).SetMaterial(0, vis_mat)

# Revolute joint for Gear B
link_revolute = chrono.ChLinkLockRevolute()
link_revolute.Initialize(mbody_gearB, mbody_train,
                         chrono.ChFramed(chrono.ChVector3d(interaxis12, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT))
sys.AddLink(link_revolute)

# Gear constraint between Gear A and Gear B
link_gearAB = chrono.ChLinkLockGear()
link_gearAB.Initialize(mbody_gearA, mbody_gearB, chrono.ChFramed())
link_gearAB.SetFrameShaft1(chrono.ChFramed(chrono.VNULL, chrono.QuatFromAngleX(-m.pi / 2)))
link_gearAB.SetFrameShaft2(chrono.ChFramed(chrono.VNULL, chrono.QuatFromAngleX(-m.pi / 2)))
link_gearAB.SetTransmissionRatio(radA / radB)
link_gearAB.SetEnforcePhase(True)
sys.AddLink(link_gearAB)

# Gear constraint between Gear B and the truss (Gear C)
radC = 2 * radB + radA
link_gearBC = chrono.ChLinkLockGear()
link_gearBC.Initialize(mbody_gearB, mbody_truss, chrono.ChFramed())
link_gearBC.SetFrameShaft1(chrono.ChFramed(chrono.VNULL, chrono.QuatFromAngleX(-m.pi / 2)))
link_gearBC.SetFrameShaft2(chrono.ChFramed(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, -4), chrono.QUNIT))
link_gearBC.SetTransmissionRatio(radB / radC)
link_gearBC.SetEpicyclic(True)
sys.AddLink(link_gearBC)

# Add Bevel Gear D
mbody_gearD = chrono.ChBodyEasyCylinder(chrono.ChAxis_X,  # Cylinder along X-axis
                                        5, 0.5,          # Radius and height
                                        1000, True, False, mat)
sys.Add(mbody_gearD)
mbody_gearD.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(-10, 0, -9))
mbody_gearD.SetRot(chrono.QuatFromAngleZ(m.pi / 2))
mbody_gearD.GetVisualShape(0).SetMaterial(0, vis_mat)

# Revolute joint for Gear D
link_revoluteD = chrono.ChLinkLockRevolute()
link_revoluteD.Initialize(mbody_truss, mbody_gearD,
                          chrono.ChFramed(chrono.ChVector3d(-10, 0, -9),
                                          chrono.QuatFromAngleY(m.pi / 2)))
sys.AddLink(link_revoluteD)

# Gear constraint between Gear A and Gear D (1:1 ratio)
link_gearAD = chrono.ChLinkLockGear()
link_gearAD.Initialize(mbody_gearA, mbody_gearD, chrono.ChFramed())
link_gearAD.SetFrameShaft1(chrono.ChFramed(chrono.VNULL, chrono.QuatFromAngleX(-m.pi / 2)))
link_gearAD.SetFrameShaft2(chrono.ChFramed(chrono.VNULL, chrono.QuatFromAngleY(-m.pi / 2)))
link_gearAD.SetTransmissionRatio(1.0)
link_gearAD.SetEnforcePhase(True)
sys.AddLink(link_gearAD)

# Add Pulley E
mbody_pulleyE = chrono.ChBodyEasyCylinder(chrono.ChAxis_X,  # Cylinder along X-axis
                                          2, 0.3,          # Radius and height
                                          1000, True, False, mat)
sys.Add(mbody_pulleyE)
mbody_pulleyE.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(-10, -11, -9))
mbody_pulleyE.SetRot(chrono.QuatFromAngleZ(m.pi / 2))
mbody_pulleyE.GetVisualShape(0).SetMaterial(0, vis_mat)

# Revolute joint for Pulley E
link_revoluteE = chrono.ChLinkLockRevolute()
link_revoluteE.Initialize(mbody_truss, mbody_pulleyE,
                          chrono.ChFramed(chrono.ChVector3d(-10, -11, -9),
                                          chrono.QuatFromAngleY(m.pi / 2)))
sys.AddLink(link_revoluteE)

# Synchro belt constraint between Gear D and Pulley E
link_beltDE = chrono.ChLinkLockGear()
link_beltDE.Initialize(mbody_gearD, mbody_pulleyE, chrono.ChFramed())
link_beltDE.SetFrameShaft1(chrono.ChFramed(chrono.VNULL, chrono.QuatFromAngleY(-m.pi / 2)))
link_beltDE.SetFrameShaft2(chrono.ChFramed(chrono.VNULL, chrono.QuatFromAngleY(-m.pi / 2)))
link_beltDE.SetTransmissionRatio(-2/5)  # Ratio based on radii (r_E / r_D)
link_beltDE.SetEnforcePhase(True)
sys.AddLink(link_beltDE)

# Visual representation of the belt between Gear D and Pulley E
belt_shape = chrono.ChVisualShapeCylinder(0.1, 11.0)
belt_body = chrono.ChBody()
belt_body.SetFixed(True)
belt_body.SetPos(chrono.ChVector3d(-10, -5.5, -9))
belt_body.AddVisualShape(belt_shape)
sys.Add(belt_body)

# Create the Irrlicht visualization
vis = chronoirr.ChVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.AttachSystem(sys)
vis.SetWindowSize(1024, 768)
vis.SetWindowTitle('Gears and pulleys')
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AddCamera(chrono.ChVector3d(12, 15, -20))
vis.AddTypicalLights()

# Set integrator type
sys.SetTimestepperType(chrono.ChTimestepper.Type_EULER_IMPLICIT_PROJECTED)

# Simulation loop
while vis.Run():
    vis.BeginScene()
    vis.Render()
    vis.EndScene()
    sys.DoStepDynamics(1e-3)
```

   - Created as a cylinder with radius `5`, positioned at `(-10, 0, -9)`, and rotated `90°` around the Z-axis.
   - Linked to the truss with a revolute joint that allows rotation around the X-axis.
   - A gear constraint with a 1:1 ratio is established between Gear A and Gear D using `ChLinkLockGear`.

2. **Pulley E**:
   - Created as a cylinder with radius `2`, positioned at `(-10, -11, -9)`, and rotated `90°` around the Z-axis.
   - Linked to the truss with a revolute joint that allows rotation around the X-axis.
   - A synchro belt constraint is implemented between Gear D and Pulley E using `ChLinkLockGear`, with a transmission ratio of `-2/5` to ensure proper synchronization.

3. **Visualization Enhancements**:
   - A simplified visual representation of the belt is added using a thin cylinder between Gear D and Pulley E.
   - All new components (Gear D and Pulley E) are assigned the same visual material as the existing gears for consistency.

- **Rotating Bar (Carrier)**: Connected to the truss via a revolute joint, allowing it to rotate freely.
- **Sun Gear**: Mounted at the center and driven by a motor to rotate at a constant angular velocity.
- **Planet Gear**: Mounted on the rotating bar and meshes with the sun gear.

```python
import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr

# Set the Chrono data path (update this to your Chrono data directory)
chrono.SetChronoDataPath('path_to_chrono_data')

# Create the physical system
system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()
system.Set_G_acc(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0))  # No gravity for simplicity

# Create the fixed truss (base)
truss = chrono.ChBody()
truss.SetBodyFixed(True)
truss.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0))
system.Add(truss)

# Add a box shape to the truss
truss_shape = chrono.ChBoxShape()
truss_shape.GetBoxGeometry().Size = chrono.ChVectorD(1, 1, 0.05)
truss.AddAsset(truss_shape)

# Create the rotating bar (carrier)
bar = chrono.ChBody()
bar.SetMass(1)
bar.SetInertiaXX(chrono.ChVectorD(0.1, 0.1, 0.1))
bar.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0.2))
system.Add(bar)

# Add a box shape to the bar
bar_shape = chrono.ChBoxShape()
bar_shape.GetBoxGeometry().Size = chrono.ChVectorD(0.25, 0.05, 0.05)  # Length = 0.5
bar.AddAsset(bar_shape)

# Add a revolute joint between the truss and the bar
revolute_bar = chrono.ChLinkRevolute()
revolute_bar.Initialize(truss, bar, chrono.ChCoordsysD(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0.2), chrono.QUNIT))
system.AddLink(revolute_bar)

# Create the sun gear
sun = chrono.ChBody()
sun.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0.2))
sun.SetMass(0.5)
sun.SetInertiaXX(chrono.ChVectorD(0.01, 0.01, 0.01))
system.Add(sun)

# Add a cylinder shape to the sun gear
sun_shape = chrono.ChCylinderShape()
sun_shape.GetCylinderGeometry().rad = 0.05
sun_shape.GetCylinderGeometry().p1 = chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, -0.02)
sun_shape.GetCylinderGeometry().p2 = chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0.02)
sun.AddAsset(sun_shape)

# Add a revolute joint between the truss and the sun gear
sun_revolute = chrono.ChLinkRevolute()
sun_revolute.Initialize(truss, sun, chrono.ChCoordsysD(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0.2), chrono.QUNIT))
system.AddLink(sun_revolute)

# Add a motor to the sun gear to enforce constant angular velocity
omega = 10  # rad/s
motor = chrono.ChLinkMotorRotationAngle()
motor.Initialize(sun, truss, chrono.ChFrameD(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0.2), chrono.QUNIT))

# Use a ramp function to define the angular position over time (constant angular velocity)
ramp = chrono.ChFunction_Ramp()
ramp.SetAngularCoeff(omega)  # slope = angular velocity
motor.SetMotorFunction(ramp)
system.AddLink(motor)

# Create the planet gear
planet = chrono.ChBody()
planet.SetMass(0.5)
planet.SetInertiaXX(chrono.ChVectorD(0.01, 0.01, 0.01))
planet.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(0.25, 0, 0.2))  # Positioned at the end of the bar
system.Add(planet)

# Add a cylinder shape to the planet gear
planet_shape = chrono.ChCylinderShape()
planet_shape.GetCylinderGeometry().rad = 0.05
planet_shape.GetCylinderGeometry().p1 = chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, -0.02)
planet_shape.GetCylinderGeometry().p2 = chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0.02)
planet.AddAsset(planet_shape)

# Add a revolute joint between the bar and the planet gear
planet_revolute = chrono.ChLinkRevolute()
planet_revolute.Initialize(bar, planet, chrono.ChCoordsysD(chrono.ChVectorD(0.25, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT))
system.AddLink(planet_revolute)

# Add a gear constraint between the sun and planet gears
gear_ratio = 1.0  # 1:1 gear ratio
link_gear = chrono.ChLinkGear()
link_gear.Initialize(sun, planet, chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 1))  # Z-axis
link_gear.SetTransmissionRatio(gear_ratio)
system.AddLink(link_gear)

# Set material properties for all bodies
mat = chrono.ChMaterialSurfaceNSC()
mat.SetFriction(0.2)
mat.SetDampingF(0.01)
mat.SetCompliance(0.0001)
mat.SetComplianceT(0.0001)

for body in [truss, bar, sun, planet]:
    body.SetMaterialSurface(mat)

# Set up Irrlicht visualization
```
